title: Conversation 2026-10-28: the arrangement fixture joins the release gate

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Reviewing srs-rust#1481 (the RFC-043 arrangement conformance runner), Claude Code fixed the runner for the scenarios srs#972 and srs#979 added. The reviewer had escalated the one-line release.yml change that adds arrangement-fixture to the release corpus-conformance gate. The owner kept it, with a review condition: revisit if releases keep getting harder.
